method: Companies whose OperatingIncomeLoss tag holds a sum of segments or an adjusted measure instead of a company-wide figure. The cell stays empty because the company reports no such figure and no reliable value exists. The source facts stay stored. A rule without facts stops the history build.

exclusions.evidence: The tag equals Pretax operating earnings (2015-2017) and Pretax adjusted earnings (2018-2022), measures that exclude investment results.
The tag equals Total segment operating income, before corporate costs.
The tag equals Reportable segments operating gain.
The tag equals Total segment operating profit, before corporate costs.
The tag equals Total Segment profit, before corporate costs.
The tag equals Total consolidated adjusted earnings, an adjusted measure.
Through fiscal 2017 the tag equals Total segment operating income. From 2018 it equals Income before interest expense and other expense, a company-wide row.
The tag equals Segment profit, summed over the reportable segments.
The tag equals Pretax operating income or Pretax segment operating income of the segment table, before charges.
The tag equals the total of the segment profit table.
